arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Because of the gassy smell, please treat this as urgent for safety. If you smell gas now: leave the flat, don't use light switches, naked flames or the oven, open doors/windows if you can on the way out, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). In immediate danger, call 999. Please don't use the oven until it has been checked. We've opened an emergency job for a Gas Safe engineer to attend; our target is within 24 hours. No firm is named yet, so we'll confirm the time as soon as we have it. The oven not heating is being looked at too. You'll hear from us again today.

Hello, the tenant of Flat 6, 56 Juniper Mews says the oven still isn't cooking properly after trying the suggested settings, and also reports an occasional gassy smell near it. We've treated the smell as an emergency: we've told her to leave and call 0800 111 999 if she smells gas, not to use the oven, and have raised an emergency job for a Gas Safe engineer to attend within 24 hours. The oven repair itself (NBL-024) remains pending; please tell us whether we may use our contractor for it.
